label: Bubble menu
desc: A round button that fans out tinted pill bubbles with a springy stagger; aria-expanded, Escape closes and returns focus.
use: Compact site menu in a corner of a hero, card or app frame (fills a position:relative parent).

label: Card nav
desc: A top bar with a menu button and call to action that expands downward into a row of link cards.
use: Marketing site header with grouped links (Product, Learn, Company).

label: Dock
desc: A magnifying icon dock: icons swell on a spring near the pointer or focus, neighbours slide aside; roving-tabindex toolbar.
use: App launcher or quick-actions strip at the bottom of an app or demo frame.

label: Flowing menu
desc: Large stacked rows; a ribbon of scrolling text slides in from the edge the pointer crossed.
use: Full-width section index or portfolio menu.

label: Gooey nav
desc: A nav bar whose active marker is a liquid blob that stretches between links through an SVG goo filter and sprays droplets.
use: Header or section switcher with a playful, liquid selection.

label: Infinite menu
desc: Menu items orbit on a draggable sphere with inertia; the facing item is described below and arrows step through items.
use: Collection or category picker where exploring is the point.

label: Line sidebar
desc: A slim rail of tick lines that stretch toward the pointer, unfold labels on hover or focus and follow scroll position.
use: In-page table of contents beside long articles or docs.

label: Pill nav
desc: A rounded pill navigation bar with circle-fill hover that folds into a menu button with a contained dropdown when narrow.

label: Staggered menu
desc: A slide-in panel with colour layers sweeping ahead and links rising in sequence; contained unless fullscreen is set.
use: Site menu for a portfolio or landing page (parent should be position:relative).

label: Stepper
desc: A multi-step flow with a progress rail, animated panels, validation, Back/Next and a finish state.
use: Onboarding, checkout or any short wizard.

label: Animated top dock
desc: A proximity-spring top navigation in three fits (centred glass dock, modern bar, pixel retro bar) chosen by a variant prop.
use: Site header with a lively hover response.
